name: conductor-oss-workspace
author: Conductor Contributors
description: Markdown-native AI agent orchestrator — dispatch coding tasks from a kanban board

scripts.build:frontend: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/openclaw-dispatcher build && bun run --cwd packages/web build
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/openclaw-dispatcher typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/web typecheck && bun run --cwd preview-worker typecheck
scripts.test:packages: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/cli test && bun run --cwd packages/openclaw-dispatcher test && bun run --cwd packages/web test && bun run --cwd preview-worker test
scripts.dev: sh -c 'APP_ROOT=$PWD; WORKSPACE_ROOT=${CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE:-${WORKSPACE:-$APP_ROOT}}; ENV_FILE=${CONDUCTOR_ENV_FILE:-}; if [ -z "$ENV_FILE" ]; then if [ -f "$APP_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$APP_ROOT/.env.local"; elif [ -f "$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then set -a; . "$ENV_FILE"; set +a; fi; CONFIG=${CO_CONFIG_PATH:-$WORKSPACE_ROOT/conductor.yaml}; DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT=${CONDUCTOR_DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}}; DEV_BACKEND_PORT=${CONDUCTOR_DEV_BACKEND_PORT:-${CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_PORT:-4749}}; CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE_ROOT CO_CONFIG_PATH=$CONFIG CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_URL=${CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_URL:-http://127.0.0.1:$DEV_BACKEND_PORT} PORT=$DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT bun run --cwd packages/web dev'
scripts.dev:backend: sh -c 'APP_ROOT=$PWD; WORKSPACE_ROOT=${CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE:-${WORKSPACE:-$APP_ROOT}}; ENV_FILE=${CONDUCTOR_ENV_FILE:-}; if [ -z "$ENV_FILE" ]; then if [ -f "$APP_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$APP_ROOT/.env.local"; elif [ -f "$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then set -a; . "$ENV_FILE"; set +a; fi; CONFIG=${CO_CONFIG_PATH:-$WORKSPACE_ROOT/conductor.yaml}; DEV_BACKEND_PORT=${CONDUCTOR_DEV_BACKEND_PORT:-${CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_PORT:-4749}}; CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE_ROOT CO_CONFIG_PATH=$CONFIG bun run --cwd packages/cli dev -- start --workspace "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" --no-dashboard --backend-port $DEV_BACKEND_PORT'
scripts.dev:full: sh -c 'APP_ROOT=$PWD; WORKSPACE_ROOT=${CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE:-${WORKSPACE:-$APP_ROOT}}; ENV_FILE=${CONDUCTOR_ENV_FILE:-}; if [ -z "$ENV_FILE" ]; then if [ -f "$APP_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$APP_ROOT/.env.local"; elif [ -f "$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local" ]; then ENV_FILE="$WORKSPACE_ROOT/.env.local"; fi; fi; if [ -n "$ENV_FILE" ] && [ -f "$ENV_FILE" ]; then set -a; . "$ENV_FILE"; set +a; fi; CONFIG=${CO_CONFIG_PATH:-$WORKSPACE_ROOT/conductor.yaml}; DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT=${CONDUCTOR_DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT:-${PORT:-3000}}; DEV_BACKEND_PORT=${CONDUCTOR_DEV_BACKEND_PORT:-${CONDUCTOR_BACKEND_PORT:-4749}}; CONDUCTOR_WORKSPACE=$WORKSPACE_ROOT CO_CONFIG_PATH=$CONFIG bun run --cwd packages/cli dev -- start --workspace "$WORKSPACE_ROOT" --backend-port $DEV_BACKEND_PORT --port $DEV_DASHBOARD_PORT'
scripts.prod:prepare: bun run --cwd packages/web build && cargo build -p conductor-cli --release
scripts.clean: bun run --cwd packages/web clean && cargo clean
